Srinidhi, saw Giift rebranded to Xoxoday and closed a Series C in January, pushing total funding past $101M.

I built a personalized signal play for Xoxoday off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the Americas team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
